gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-118.255517 34.046847)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] > 1200 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

WITH hotel_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-118.255517 34.046847)'), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
elevation_raster AS (
  SELECT rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(
    ST_Transform(rast, 4326)::geography,
    (SELECT geom FROM hotel_geom)
  )
),
high_points AS (
  SELECT
    (ST_DumpAsPolygons(ST_Clip(rast, true, ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(geom, 4326), 100000), 1))).geom AS geom
  FROM elevation_raster, hotel_geom
  WHERE ST_Value(rast, (ST_DumpAsPolygons(ST_Clip(rast, true, ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(geom, 4326), 100000), 1))).geom, 1) > 1200
),
closest_point AS (
  SELECT
    ST_ClosestPoint(high_points.geom, (SELECT geom FROM hotel_geom)) AS geom
  FROM high_points
  ORDER BY ST_Distance(high_points.geom, (SELECT geom FROM hotel_geom))
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  ST_Distance(
    (SELECT geom FROM hotel_geom),
    (SELECT geom FROM closest_point)
  ) AS distance_meters;
